# 用Discord做金融科技，月入12000美元

![封面图](https://i.imgur.com/xiGjSYF.jpeg)

**> 作者: NVSTly创始人**

**> 标签: 金融科技、Discord、投资**

你有没有因为一个路怒事件改变人生？

他有。

--

Young teen时就对写code感兴趣，back in 2003。

但只是"script kiddie"，没有exceptional coding skills pursue as career。

Instead became machinist。

Happy with trade，所以没pursue entrepreneurship until 2020。

All started with road rage incident。

--

Red light停下，window down，suddenly有人approach，precise left hook。

可能inadvertently cut someone off或没let them merge，details unclear。

Impact left him feeling dazed，regained composure时对方already won and left。

Licked wounds继续走，nearly week later realize something seriously wrong。

Jaw broken。

手术wired shut几周，然后发现not healed properly，又做一次手术restart healing process。

Setback，但gave downtime。

在那downtime里，really immersed into stock market，essentially became full-time day trader。

Blessing in disguise。

--

Eyes stayed glued to stock和crypto markets即使healed之后。

2020和2021年bull market里got really lucky。

--

GME squeeze fully underway，Reddit's r/wallstreetbuzzing。

Tons of trading communities on Discord exploding，他actively taking part。

Looking for app或Discord bot fit use case时，noticed gap in fintech market。

想要ability track all buy/sell signals和trades sharing，calculate performance stats，share without showing position sizes或balances。

Despite fintech space的many difficulties——expensive financial data、tons of regulation——set out build solution。

Own need validated idea，felt confident。

True validation wouldn't come until users actively engaged with platform。

--

现在NVSTly月入8000-12000美元。

Social investing platform in fintech industry。

Traders可以track、share、copy trades with extensive insights on every position、in-depth performance stats。

Optional brokerage integration可以automate entire process。

Follow top traders、receive real-time notifications of their trades，或compete against best earn recognition、rank at top of leaderboards。

--

可以manually submit trades on web、mobile apps（Google Play和Apple App Store）、或直接Discord上用unique bot。

Bot是only one of its kind，fastest-growing fintech bot on Discord，now in over 4500 communities。

Support almost all financial markets，including stocks、options、cryptocurrency（25+ exchanges），futures和forex support coming soon。

--

Paired with trading community on Discord with over 40k users，newcomers可以learn investing和trading through abundance of educational material、access analysis content、hear about trends early，veterans可以collaborate on strategies、technical analysis、earn recognition for contributions。

还有roughly 100 free Discord bots known as Tickerbots，display asset's price in nickname updating every ~10 seconds。

--

Getting here wasn't easy。

Out of depth with development和vast scope of envisioned platform，needed team。

Invested 5k-6k美元from day trading赚的钱into business，portion用来contract designer。

About week or two working together后，designer attempted strong arm him for 51% ownership。

Claimed could have devised all his ideas、concepts、detailed outlines himself，then threatened leave and develop project independently。

Politely told him to kick rocks，best of luck with his project。

--

Few days later，encountered him in web-design server on Discord seeking feedback on design they had been working on。

Someone responded with own spin on design，turned out significantly better。

Seeing this，reached out to that individual，explained situation，paid roughly 2k美元handle design。

--

No experience in Discord's API、little desire learn it，next found developer。

Contracted team of two——one frontend、one backend。

Frontend guy delaying project，eventually asked backend guy——Meow——if could do both。

Agreed，knocked both out within few weeks。

--

Meow really caught him off guard。

Reaching nearly all development milestones outlined，felt time extend offer for partnership和equity——wanted keep momentum，need him stay on as lead developer。

Initially proposed 25% stake，condition if signed that day，would cover remaining budget。

Countered with 30%，sealed deal that day。

Interestingly，regardless of equity percentages，split profit equally，50/50 split。

--

Wasn't until about year later，established LLC，found out first name——and he was only 14 years old when first contracted him。

Remains quite secretive about personal life。

--

Meow用TypeScript和HTML/CSS for web，SQLite database，Node.js build MVP。

Not until v1 used React，then v2 used Svelte、switched to MongoDB for DB。

Meanwhile他built community to few thousand members，many daily active users，small but skilled team of three solid traders providing quality content by September 2021 when released bot和web app，starting open beta testing。

Small team of traders in Discord community provided buy/sell signals，making early revisions和bug fixes easier due to ample feedback，along with input from dozen or so communities that first invited bot。

Within first week，garnered 20 active communities，over following five weeks consistently released content-rich changelogs keep user base informed。

By fourth week，Discord bot attained verification status after being adopted by 75 communities。

--

Since social platform，focus on helping users earn money，rather than taking their money。

Prioritizing monetization misguided for social platform。

Instead of concentrating on bottom line或generating revenue，social platform should aim provide value、create fun user experience that retains attention、offer incentives for users keep interacting和coming back。

Aware need make money，working on it，但strongly believe when social platform experiences strong growth和significant daily/monthly activity，opportunities for various revenue streams will naturally follow。

--

Current revenue from：
- Subscriptions (~7k MRR)
- Affiliate partnerships with crypto exchanges (1k-2k/月)
- Paid posts (250-800/月)
- White labeling Discord bot (550/月)

Despite revenue，only surpassed 1k profit couple of times。

Keep most costs low with out-of-the-box thinking——free market data by including attribution、running 50/月 VPS等——但spend 65-85% revenue on team via revenue-sharing model。

Makes sense for now，they are main reason members subscribe to 24/月 membership。

--

Discord是roots。

Growing community there integral to platform's和company's initial traction和ongoing growth。

Helpful that many traders who joined community have own followings，resulting organic growth as their followers joined platform。

Discord bot fosters engagement和activity within communities，leading to more servers inviting bot naturally。

Designed so users have to signup with NVSTly to follow traders和receive real-time notifications，means these other servers give users。

When users share trades in Discord，bot submits和tracks those trades，responding with confirmation to each position update——response contains link to Trade Insight UI within bot's embed，allowing followers access more insights about position with simple click。

Additionally，users share dashboard links showcase trade history和performance stats。

All beneficial to trader，also spreads awareness——and adoption——of platform。

--

Build和grow community on Discord requires significant amount of time和effort，especially if starting from scratch without existing network或following。

Tips：

1. **Offer value或incentives**：Clearly communicate why users should join和engage。Quality content provides value，while exclusive content offers incentive。Identify what makes server unique和better than others。

2. **Welcome new users**：Personally welcome new members。Simple greeting、asking how day been can make them feel valued、more likely engage。Also boosts message activity，encouraging more users join conversation。

3. **Utilize Discord server listing sites**：Take advantage of platforms like Disboard、Discord.me等。Actively "bump" server keep at top或front of listings as often as possible attract new members。

4. **Events、activities、giveaways**：Host event或group activity。Giveaways almost never fail，might only offer short lived engagement。Make giveaway requirements user has to be in server X days eligible（prevents botters和alts），send X messages since announcement（drives up engagement）等。

--

Controversial tips：

Small server时，all about building total user count。

Need 1000 users listed on Discord Discovery。

Sometimes need 'fake it till you make it'。

If have verification method，don't kick out users who haven't verified。

Create quarantine channel或role——still count toward server's member count。

Advertising servers where can sponsor Nitro giveaway for around 15美元。

These servers announce giveaway to all their users，requirement win is must be in your server on day of giveaway。

Might attract some alt accounts或bots，okay when starting out。

Once listed on Discord Discovery，can set aside these controversial tips。

Potential users still more likely join servers with higher member counts，but also want good online-to-total user count ratio。

If have thousands of users but only 2-3 active chatters，can appear bit "sus"。

--

Launched on Product Hunt twice。

Decent following on X和Stocktwits。

Grown by automating process of posting great content shared in Discord server。

Analysts share charts或analysis in public Discord channels，automatically post to X和Stocktwits，including any images。

Reaching out to small和medium-sized finance influencers on X/Twitter on radar for near future。

Plan focus on short-form video content for TikTok、Instagram、YouTube too。

Also testing ads in Google Play、Apple App Store、Meta。

--

Unlike other ventures，can't simply take break from social platform pursue new project without risking degradation。

But okay。

Personally believe work-life balance overrated for startup founders。

Thriving as founder requires small dose of insanity和all-in mentality。

If not willing make sacrifices in life或even impact mental health achieve success，perhaps endeavor isn't worth effort。

When deeply passionate about work或engaged in meaningful project，boundaries between work和personal life can blur。

Work doesn't necessarily feel like burden but rather integral part of identity和fulfillment。

--

Avoid burnout by approaching work with focus on productivity和efficiency。

Times enter productive flow、maintain momentum，completing tasks one after another。

Mindful of reaching point where continuing becomes counterproductive。

Like any streak，natural end，crucial identify that point avoid diminishing returns。

--

Primary goal realize entire vision had for platform since inception，seems endless given abundance of ideas。

To get there，probably need raise funding。

With sufficient funding market和promote platform，can gain more traction。

Platform will improve as more users join和interact，as with any social platform。

--
